capabilities: Search notes by keyword and by meaning
Group notes into topics in a graph
Chat with an agent that reads and writes notes
Draw charts and dashboards from notes as widgets
Run on local or cloud model providers
disambiguation: Not a note-taking or knowledge-base system of its own; it adds search, a topic graph and an AI agent on top of notes you already have.
extras: Search and the Smart Graph work without any AI provider; an embedding model is needed for semantic search and topic grouping, and an AI provider for the agent. Setup guides, a demo video and documentation live on smartsecondbrain.dev. A daily update check fetches the manifest from GitHub and can be turned off in settings.
problem: Keyword search misses the note you were thinking of, the vault's overall topics are not visible anywhere, and no assistant can answer from your own notes.
summary: Free, open-source plugin that adds meaning-based search, a graph grouping notes into topics, and an AI agent that can read and write notes.
